title: 25 Olive Oil Myths That Won't Die
seoTitle: 25 Olive Oil Myths That Won't Die
excerpt: A lot of what people believe about olive oil is marketing, habit, or a good story that happens to be wrong. Twenty-five of the most common myths, grouped by where they come from, and what holds up instead.
seoDescription: Colour, cold pressed, best-before dates, the fridge test: 25 olive oil myths taken apart, and the two things that tell you an oil is worth buying.
